title: Cocos 3.8 3D Node Touch Event Crash (cameraPriority)
content: In Cocos Creator 3.8, registering node.on(Node.EventType.TOUCH_START) on a 3D Node causes PointerEventDispatcher._sortPointerEventProcessorList to crash with TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'cameraPriority') because node._getUITransformComp() is null on 3D nodes. To handle 3D interaction or screen taps, always use global input.on(Input.EventType.TOUCH_START) combined with Camera.screenPointToRay() and PhysicsSystem/geometry raycast, NEVER register Node.EventType.TOUCH_* on non-UI 3D nodes.

title: Cocos Creator 3.8 Math Type Allocation Rule
content: Always import math types from 'cc': Vec3, Quat, Color, tween, instantiate. Never allocate new objects (new Vec3(), new Quat()) inside update(dt) loops. Reuse static temporary vectors or pre-allocated instance fields to prevent Garbage Collection pauses in mobile playable ads.

title: Playable Ad Store Redirection Hook
content: Wire SuperHtmlPlayable.download() or super_html.download() for CTA clicks across all ad networks. Use PlayableCTAController to handle Google, AppLovin, IronSource, Unity, Mintegral, TikTok channels with proper fallback store URLs.

title: Mobile Web Audio Autoplay Unlock on First Touch
content: Mobile browsers (iOS Safari, Android Chrome) block web audio autoplay by default. Always resume AudioContext on the first touch event (in PlayableAudioController or GameEntry) and check platform audio guidelines via super_html.is_audio().

title: Cocos 3.8 Responsive Canvas Widget Configuration
content: When creating Playable UI Canvas in Cocos 3.8, always attach Widget with fitWidth/fitHeight or alignFlags 45 to ensure responsive mobile layout in both portrait and landscape orientations.

title: Migration from legacy assets/script/playable_core to playable-shared-kit packages
content: Deprecated and deleted legacy assets/script/playable_core folder. All core runtime code and SDK analytics/CTA wrappers are now sourced cleanly from playable-shared-kit packages (playable-core and playable-sdk) and imported via standard npm package paths. Fixed TS import extensions in playable-core and playable-sdk.

title: Offline FFmpeg Audio Optimizer for Cocos Playable Ads
content: Added offline FFmpeg audio optimizer CLI tool to playable-shared-kit/tools/audio-optimizer.cjs. Supports converting sound assets to MP3 or OGG, quality presets (20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%), mono downmixing, sample rate scaling, and Cocos Creator .meta synchronization with UUID preservation. Multi-tier FFmpeg resolver checks CLI path, env FFMPEG_PATH, portable dependency/ffmpeg, ffmpeg-static, system PATH, and standard OS directories.

title: Portable Runnable Dependencies in playable-shared-kit/tools/dependency
content: Configured tools/dependency/ to house self-contained portable runnable binaries: Python 3.11 embeddable (dependency/python/python.exe), Standalone uv (dependency/uv/uv.exe), and Standalone FFmpeg (dependency/ffmpeg/bin/ffmpeg.exe). All tools (ensure-dependencies.cjs, audio-optimizer.cjs, mcp-clients-sync.ps1) prioritize local-dependency paths first. Added npm run dependencies:setup to automatically provision all portable runtimes on fresh machines.

title: Cocos Creator 3.8 Playable Shared Kit Sync Architecture
content: Refactored playable-shared-kit packages (playable-sdk, playable-core) as single-source-of-truth. Implemented sync-shared-kit.cjs to sync packages to assets/script/shared/ with deterministic Cocos Creator .meta preservation. Avoided Cocos Creator 3.8 'Unexpected export statement in CJS module' error by eliminating faulty tarball npm packaging. All boilerplate controllers and demo scenes (Boilerplate.scene, Gameplay.scene) wired to ../shared.

title: Zero-Scene-Tweak Scriptable JSON Config Architecture for Cocos Creator 3.8
content: To eliminate merge conflicts and simplify ad variant creation, avoid hardcoding/tuning properties on scene node inspectors. All gameplay, CTA links, audio volumes, camera presets, and custom mechanics are centralized in assets/resources/playable-config.json and managed by PlayableConfigManager in playable-core. Built extensions/json-scriptable-inspector for Cocos Creator 3.8 to view and edit JSON files as Unity ScriptableObject-style visual forms with direct Save (Ctrl+S) and AssetDB reimport capabilities.
